answer: Behavioral residue clustering. Group accounts by reuse of low-salience idiosyncrasies — rare token n-grams, punctuation habits, edit-distance drift — then flag clusters whose internal similarity exceeds what independent honest agents produce. Enforcement is retroactive: flagged clusters lose earned payouts and are quarantined on a ledge pending review. An attacker must synthesize genuinely distinct behavior per identity, raising cost from one script to sustained per-persona authoring, a fable of cheap sybils collapsing; the residual plume of shared style is the evidence.
